entries.title: Psalms 22:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Aijeleth-Shahar. A Psalm of David.>> My *God, my *God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou] far from my salvation, from the words of my groaning?

entries.title: Psalms 22:2
segments: My God, I cry by day, and thou answerest not; and by night, and there is no rest for me:

entries.title: Psalms 22:3
segments: And thou art holy, thou that dwellest amid the praises of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 22:4
segments: Our fathers confided in thee: they confided, and thou didst deliver them.

entries.title: Psalms 22:5
segments: They cried unto thee, and were delivered; they confided in thee, and were not confounded.

entries.title: Psalms 22:6
segments: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and the despised of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 22:7
segments: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying:]

entries.title: Psalms 22:8
segments: Commit it to Jehovah--let him rescue him; let him deliver him, because he delighteth in him!

entries.title: Psalms 22:9
segments: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; thou didst make me trust, upon my mother's breasts.

entries.title: Psalms 22:10
segments: I was cast upon thee from the womb; thou art my *God from my mother's belly.

entries.title: Psalms 22:11
segments: ¶Be not far from me, for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

entries.title: Psalms 22:12
segments: Many bulls have encompassed me; Bashan's strong ones have beset me round.

entries.title: Psalms 22:13
segments: They gape upon me with their mouth, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion.

entries.title: Psalms 22:14
segments: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is become like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

entries.title: Psalms 22:15
segments: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue cleaveth to my palate; and thou hast laid me in the dust of death.

entries.title: Psalms 22:16
segments: For dogs have encompassed me; an assembly of evil-doers have surrounded me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

entries.title: Psalms 22:17
segments: I may count all my bones. They look, they stare upon me;

entries.title: Psalms 22:18
segments: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

entries.title: Psalms 22:19
segments: But thou, Jehovah, be not far [from me]; O my strength, haste thee to help me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:20
segments: Deliver my soul from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog;

entries.title: Psalms 22:21
segments: Save me from the lion's mouth. Yea, from the horns of the buffaloes hast thou answered me.

entries.title: Psalms 22:22
segments: ¶I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 22:23
segments: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and revere him, all ye the seed of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 22:24
segments: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him: but when he cried unto him, he heard.

entries.title: Psalms 22:25
segments: My praise is from thee, in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

entries.title: Psalms 22:26
segments: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; they shall praise Jehovah that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 22:27
segments: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah, and all the families of the nations shall worship before thee:

entries.title: Psalms 22:28
segments: For the kingdom is Jehovah's, and he ruleth among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 22:29
segments: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship; all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, and he that cannot keep alive his own soul.

entries.title: Psalms 22:30
segments: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

entries.title: Psalms 22:31
segments: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [it].
